evaluation_end_rule: last complete month common to settlement-verified hub prices, current monthly admin rates, daily preliminary operating reserve rates, timestamped load forecasts and preliminary actual load; do not select end from returns
refit: monthly expanding; earlier evaluation labels may enter subsequent fits only after 90-day embargo
primary_direction: INC or no trade only; no DEC
entry_rule: predict spread median > training-average INC cost + 0.50 USD/MWh
features: same CAL + LOAD columns as signal v1; no contemporaneous realized errors
controls_entry: INC controls use same cost+0.50 gate; squared two-way uses original v1 cost-only directional gate
cost_base: same RTO + East, admin and submission fees; fixed invoices separate
inference: paired circular 7-day daily blocks, 2000 draws, seed 31027; comparisons versus Always INC, calendar absolute INC and equal-total-volume INC
loss_interpretation: absolute loss estimates a conditional median, not expected cash profit; evaluation retains every original tail loss without trimming
selection_status: post-hoc v2 designed after reviewing 2022-2025; report all frozen controls, do not tune from 2026 results
prior_exposure: 2026 DA prices previously used in another project; no claim of completely untouched market outcomes
publication_status: creation timestamps plus assumed 15-minute buffer; not independently verified publication history
run_policy: freeze configuration hash before inspecting 2026 outcome values; one evaluation run; retain unsuccessful results
